description: Look up an author by slug (e.g., "albert-einstein"). Returns bio, description, and total quote count. Without a slug, returns a page of the author list — the upstream list is unordered and cannot be searched, so prefer passing a slug.

limit.description: Authors per page when browsing without a slug (1–100, default 20; rounded up to 10/25/50/100)

slug.description: Author slug(s) to look up, e.g. "albert-einstein". Supports pipe-separated values for multiple authors.

name: get_authors
